quizzes.question: What makes Jidoka different from ordinary automation?
options: It detects a defined abnormality, stops, and calls a person
It needs no people at all
quizzes.explanation: Automation does the work; Jidoka also judges it. It stops on a defined abnormality and signals for human help, so defects don't multiply.

quizzes.question: An operator sees an abnormal seal, but the line is behind target. What should she do?
options: Keep going and report it at the end of the shift
Call Andon and hold the unit, as the stop rules say
Fix it quietly herself and carry on
quizzes.explanation: No defect forward, no abnormality hidden. Calling Andon and holding the unit protects the customer, even when output is behind.
